title: WHEN HUMAN STRENGTH FAILS
REMEMBRANCE IN GOD
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering

scenes.a: Human strength feels fragile as trouble gathers today.
Scriptural truth declares, Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
scenes.sub: WE REMEMBER THE NAME OF THE LORD

scenes.a: Heavenly Father, when earthly systems shake and earthly defenses fail, anchor our weary hearts in Your holy name.
scenes.sub: ANCHOR OUR HEARTS IN YOUR NAME

scenes.a: Deliver us from the snare of fear, protect our homes from unseen danger, and shield our minds from quiet dread.
We lay down our self-reliance today and stand secure beneath Your Almighty covering.
Amen. Even when trouble gathers today.
